response.text:
I can do that. Quick plan and a couple of choices so you know what I’ll do if you say “go”:

Proposed default (recommended)
- Target: all messages with the Gmail search label:Newsletters older_than:1y
- Exceptions: skip starred messages and skip unread messages (so you don’t lose something you’ve flagged or not yet seen)
- Action: move to Trash (recoverable for 30 days) — this removes them from your inbox/label but lets you recover anything accidentally removed.

Other options (pick one)
- Permanently delete now (irreversible) — removes immediately.
- Archive instead of trashing — removes from the label/inbox but keeps in All Mail.
- Put them in a new label “Old Newsletters” and archive — keeps them separate but out of the main label.

I’ll use the Gmail search query (by default):
label:Newsletters older_than:1y -is:starred -is:unread

Before I proceed I need your confirmation on:
1) Proceed with the recommended default (move to Trash, skip starred/unread)? OR choose one of the other options above?
2) If you prefer deletion now, confirm you want irreversible deletion.

Tell me which option you want and I’ll run it. (I won’t make any changes until you confirm.)
